column3: “Any flimsy wall that is built” replaces one building a wall.
“I will send” replaces the address to the falling hailstones.
“You will not be asked” reverses the expected affirmative force of the Hebrew question.
“The city” supplies the subject of falling.
“Magic” specifies the bands, and “their wrists” replaces the Hebrew reference to the joints of My hands.
The strengthening of hands is rendered as encouragement.
